note: Inputs reference context.templates by templateId and context.layers by layer hash. Compare decision, failing, results (layer, id, result, reason), statementsUsed, statementsRejected, inputsHash and effectiveHash. Cost units and messages are implementation-defined.

owner-wallet/procurement@1.description: Bounded procurement budget for an agent: agent + co-signer spend within policy; the owner (treasury) can always act alone (catalog B1)

settlement-vault/hotel@1.description: Prepaid booking with confirmation deadline, dispute window and arbiter (docs/use-cases/hotel-booking.md)

owner-wallet/shopping@1.description: Bounded consumer-shopping budget for an agent: agent + co-signer spend within a weekly cap to category-approved merchants; the owner can always act alone (catalog R2)

settlement-vault/hotel@2.description: Prepaid booking with deposit, check-in/no-show handling, dispute windows, arbiter and backup arbiter (hotel stay escrow)

rules.title: Sent from the deal's own account
rules.check: tx.account == eng.account && tx.innerAccounts().all(a, a == eng.account || (stage == 'open' && eng.parties.exists(k, eng.parties[k] == a)))
rules.message: The co-signer only signs transactions that move money out of this deal's single-use account, never anything that touches someone else's account.

rules.title: Allowed kinds of transaction
rules.message: Each step may only use the transaction types it needs (payments, closing the account…). Handing control of the account to a new key is never allowed.

rules.title: Network fee is reasonable
rules.message: The XRPL fee must stay under a cap, so a transaction can't quietly drain the account's XRP reserve.

rules.title: Expires quickly if not used
rules.check: stage in params.presignedStages || (tx.hasLastLedgerSequence && tx.lastLedgerSequence <= ledgerIndex + params.maxLedgerWindow)
rules.message: A live transaction must expire within a few ledgers (seconds), so a signed one can't be held back and used later. Pre-signed defaults are exempt; they're guarded by the other checks.

rules.title: All-or-nothing
rules.message: When several payments go together, either all of them happen or none do. No half-paid outcome is possible.

rules.title: Pays only people in the deal
rules.message: Money may only go to the guest, the hotel, the arbiters, or the service's fee account, never to an outsider.

rules.title: Closes the account cleanly
rules.message: Closing the account must pay out every last cent and then delete it. If the payouts don't add up to exactly what's in the account, it would leave money stranded.

rules.title: Says which outcome it is
rules.message: Every signed transaction carries a note naming the outcome it executes (agreed settlement, refund, ruling…), so the ledger history explains itself.

rules.title: No other outcome in progress
rules.message: Only one ending can be in flight at a time. If one was just signed and is still settling, a second one waits, so the deal can't be paid out twice.

rules.title: Right token issuer
rules.message: Every amount must be in the real RLUSD token from its official issuer, not a look-alike.

rules.title: The ledger would accept it right now
rules.message: Pre-signed endings can only be tried once: a failed attempt burns them. So the co-signer only signs one when the account is in exactly the state that makes it succeed, including being old enough to be deleted.

rules.title: Owner’s spending mandate is valid
rules.message: The agent can only spend under a mandate the owner signed, and only until it expires.

rules.title: A plain vendor payment
rules.message: A spend is one to four payments to vendors, and nothing else.

rules.title: Approved, verified vendor
rules.check: tx.payouts.destinations().all(d, d in mandate.vendors && ledger.hasCredential(d, params.kybType, params.kybIssuers))
rules.message: Every payee must be on the owner’s vendor list and hold a business-verification (KYB) credential from an accepted issuer.

rules.title: Within the daily cap
rules.message: Everything spent in the last 24 hours, including payments still settling, stays under the mandate’s daily limit.

rules.title: Within the overall budget
rules.message: Everything spent over the mandate’s 90-day period, including payments still settling, stays within its budget.

rules.title: Large payment approved
rules.check: tx.payouts.count() == 1 && att.list('approval.payment/1', 'approver').exists(a, a.subject.intentHash == tx.intentHash() && now < timestamp(a.claim.notAfter))
rules.message: Payments over the approval threshold need a one-time approval from the owner’s approver, tied to this exact payment.

rules.title: Matches a vendor invoice
rules.check: tx.payouts.items.all(p, att.list('party.invoice/1', 'vendor').exists(i, i.attester.account == p.to && amt(i.claim.amount, 'RLUSD') == p.amount && i.claim.invoiceRef == tx.memo('eng/invoice')))
rules.message: Each payment must match an invoice the vendor signed: same amount, same invoice number.

rules.title: Matches the merchant’s payment request
rules.message: When paying a merchant’s x402 request, the payment must go to the address, for the amount and invoice, that the merchant asked for, so it can’t be redirected or replayed.

rules.title: Valid owner close
rules.message: The owner closes the account by sweeping everything back to themselves, then deleting it.

rules.title: Confirms the guest’s actual booking
rules.message: The hotel’s confirmation must point to the guest’s own booking request.

rules.title: Right city and dates
rules.check: att.latest('party.confirmation/1', 'counterparty').claim.city == mandate.constraints.city && att.latest('party.confirmation/1', 'counterparty').claim.checkIn == mandate.constraints.checkIn && att.latest('party.confirmation/1', 'counterparty').claim.checkOut == mandate.constraints.checkOut
rules.message: The confirmed city and check-in/check-out dates must match what the guest asked for.

rules.title: Right price
rules.message: The confirmed total must equal the room price the guest paid in.

rules.title: Deal is ready to settle
rules.message: Settlement happens once the booking is confirmed or the stay is over, and never while a guest dispute is open.

rules.title: Valid settlement
rules.message: An agreed settlement splits the money between guest and hotel and closes the account, in one transaction.

rules.title: Correct service fee
rules.message: The service takes 0.5% of whatever the hotel receives.

rules.title: Guest left a review
rules.message: A stay settles together with the guest’s review, so every completed booking leaves a reputation record.

rules.title: Refund is due
rules.message: The automatic refund is only for a booking the hotel never confirmed by its deadline.

rules.title: Account holds just the room price
rules.message: This refund was signed in advance for exactly the room price. If anything else is in the account now (such as a dispute bond), it no longer fits.

rules.title: Valid refund
rules.message: The automatic refund sends the room price back to the guest and closes the account.

rules.title: Release is due
rules.message: The “nobody acted” release only fires after the guest’s window to dispute has closed.

rules.title: No open dispute
rules.message: If the guest filed a dispute, the release waits for the arbiter. Silence can’t override a raised flag.

rules.title: Account holds just the room price
rules.message: The release was signed in advance for exactly the room price. If anything else is in the account, it no longer fits.

rules.title: Valid release
rules.message: The release pays the room to the hotel (less the fee) and closes the account.

rules.title: Owner’s spending mandate is valid
rules.message: The agent can only spend under a mandate the owner signed, and only until it expires.

rules.title: A plain merchant payment
rules.message: A spend is one to four payments to merchants, and nothing else.

rules.title: Allowed kind of shop
rules.check: tx.payouts.destinations().all(d, att.list('merchant.category/1', 'classifier').exists(c, c.subject.account == d && c.claim.category in mandate.categories))
rules.message: Every merchant must be classified by an accepted classifier into a category the owner allowed (for example groceries).

rules.title: Within the weekly cap
rules.message: Everything spent in the last 7 days, including payments still settling, stays under the mandate’s weekly limit.

rules.title: Within the overall budget
rules.message: Everything spent over the mandate’s 90-day period, including payments still settling, stays within its budget.

rules.title: Matches the merchant’s payment request
rules.message: When paying a merchant’s x402 or MPP request, the payment must go to the address, for the amount and invoice, that the merchant asked for, so it can’t be redirected or replayed.

rules.title: Valid owner close
rules.message: The owner closes the account by sweeping everything back to themselves, then deleting it.

definitions.confirmed: def.conf != null && def.conf.claim.mandateHash == eng.mandateId && def.conf.claim.city == mandate.constraints.city && def.conf.claim.checkIn == mandate.constraints.checkIn && def.conf.claim.checkOut == mandate.constraints.checkOut && amt(def.conf.claim.total.value, 'RLUSD') == def.booked && def.deposit <= amt(mandate.constraints.maxDeposit.value, 'RLUSD')
definitions.checkedIn: def.conf != null && att.latest('party.checkin/1', 'counterparty') != null && att.latest('party.checkin/1', 'counterparty').claim.status == 'checked_in' && def.balance >= def.booked + def.deposit
definitions.disputeOpen: ledger.credentialExists(eng.parties.principal, eng.account, 'ENG/DISPUTE') && size(def.disputes) > 0 && def.balance >= def.booked + (def.checkedIn ? def.deposit : zero('RLUSD')) + amt(params.minDisputeBond, 'RLUSD')
definitions.conceded: def.entryDispute && att.list('party.concession/1', 'counterparty').exists(c, def.disputes.exists(d, d.claim.phase == 'entry' && d.id == c.claim.disputeRef))
definitions.disputeOpenedAt: size(def.settlementDisputes) > 0 ? (timestamp(def.settlementDisputes[0].issuedAt) > timestamp(eng.timers.deliveryBy) ? timestamp(def.settlementDisputes[0].issuedAt) : timestamp(eng.timers.deliveryBy)) : (timestamp(def.entryDisputes[0].issuedAt) > timestamp(eng.timers.checkIn) ? timestamp(def.entryDisputes[0].issuedAt) : timestamp(eng.timers.checkIn))

rules.title: Confirms the guest's actual booking
rules.message: The hotel's confirmation must point to the guest's own booking request.

rules.title: Right city and dates
rules.check: def.conf.claim.city == mandate.constraints.city && def.conf.claim.checkIn == mandate.constraints.checkIn && def.conf.claim.checkOut == mandate.constraints.checkOut
rules.message: The confirmed city and check-in/check-out dates must match what the guest asked for.

rules.title: Right price
rules.message: The confirmed total must equal the room price the guest paid in.

rules.title: Deposit within the guest's limit
rules.message: The security deposit the hotel asks for must not exceed the maximum the guest agreed to. Otherwise the confirmation doesn't count.

rules.title: Guest checked in
rules.message: The hotel has recorded the guest's arrival, and the deposit is in the account.

rules.title: Deposit is exactly right
rules.message: The account holds the room price plus exactly the confirmed deposit, no more, no less.

rules.title: Valid settlement
rules.message: An agreed settlement splits the money between guest and hotel and closes the account, in one transaction.

rules.title: Correct service fee
rules.message: The service takes 0.5% of whatever the hotel receives. Refunds to the guest carry no fee.

rules.title: Guest left a review
rules.message: A stay that happened settles together with the guest's review, so every completed booking leaves a reputation record.

rules.title: Pays only guest, hotel and fee
rules.message: A settlement can only pay the guest, the hotel, and the service fee, never the arbiters or anyone else.

rules.title: Hotel admitted the problem
rules.message: There must be an open check-in dispute from the guest, and the hotel's own statement conceding it.

rules.title: Valid refund
rules.message: A conceded refund sends everything to the guest and closes the account, in one transaction.

rules.title: Full refund
rules.message: Everything in the account goes back to the guest, including any deposit and the dispute bond, with no fee.

rules.title: Refund is due
rules.message: The automatic refund is only for a booking the hotel never confirmed by its deadline. If the hotel confirmed in time, it doesn't apply.

rules.title: Account holds just the room price
rules.message: This refund was signed in advance for exactly the room price. If anything else is in the account now (a deposit, a dispute bond), it no longer fits.

rules.title: Valid refund
rules.message: The automatic refund sends the room price back to the guest and closes the account.

rules.title: No-show is due
rules.message: A no-show only counts after the last check-in time and after the guest's window to dispute at check-in has closed.

rules.title: Booking was confirmed
rules.message: Only a confirmed booking can end in a no-show. An unconfirmed one ends in a refund instead.

rules.title: Guest never checked in
rules.message: If the guest arrived and paid the deposit, it isn't a no-show.

rules.title: No open dispute
rules.message: If the guest filed a dispute (with its bond), the automatic endings wait for the arbiter. Silence can't override a raised flag.

rules.title: Account holds just the room price
rules.message: The no-show ending was signed in advance for exactly the room price. If anything else is in the account now, it no longer fits.

rules.title: Valid no-show payout
rules.message: The no-show ending pays the room to the hotel (less the fee) and closes the account.

rules.title: Correct service fee
rules.message: The service takes 0.5% of whatever the hotel receives.

rules.title: Release is due
rules.message: The 'nobody acted' release only fires after the guest's window to dispute has closed, and only for a stay that happened.

rules.title: No open dispute
rules.message: If the guest filed a dispute (with its bond), the release waits for the arbiter. Silence can't override a raised flag.

rules.title: Account holds room plus deposit
rules.message: The release was signed in advance for the room plus the deposit. If anything else is in the account, it no longer fits.

rules.title: Valid release
rules.message: The release pays the room to the hotel, returns the deposit to the guest, and closes the account.

rules.title: No deposit claim posted
rules.message: If the hotel claimed against the deposit, the release can't just return it: the claim has to be agreed, or ruled on.

rules.title: Deposit goes back in full
rules.check: def.toGuest == def.deposit && def.toFee == bps(def.toMerchant + def.toFee, params.serviceFeeBps)
rules.message: The whole deposit returns to the guest; the hotel gets the room price less the fee.

rules.title: Primary arbiter's time ran out
rules.check: (def.disputeOpen && now > def.disputeOpenedAt + duration(params.rulingWindow)) || (def.claim != null && !def.disputeOpen && now > timestamp(eng.timers.disputeWindowEnds) + duration(params.rulingWindow))
rules.message: The backup arbiter may only rule once the primary arbiter's ruling window has passed without a ruling.

rules.title: Primary arbiter hasn't ruled
rules.message: If the primary arbiter already ruled, the backup steps aside.

rules.title: Backup arbiter has ruled
rules.message: There must be a signed ruling from the backup arbiter.

rules.title: Pays exactly what was ruled
rules.check: size(def.backupRuling.claim.payouts) == tx.payouts.count() && def.backupRuling.claim.payouts.all(p, def.backupRuling.claim.payouts.filter(q, q.to == p.to).size() == 1 && tx.payouts.to(p.to, 'RLUSD') == amt(p.value, 'RLUSD')) && tx.payouts.destinations().all(d, def.backupRuling.claim.payouts.exists(p, p.to == d))
rules.message: The transaction must pay exactly the amounts in the backup arbiter's ruling, to exactly those people.

rules.title: Valid ruling payout
rules.message: A ruling splits the money and closes the account, in one transaction.

rules.title: Correct service fee
rules.message: The service takes 0.5% of whatever the hotel receives.

rules.title: Hotel posted a claim
rules.message: A default ruling only exists to settle a deposit claim the guest never answered.

rules.title: Guest didn't dispute
rules.message: If the guest disputed the claim, the arbiter rules on the dispute instead.

rules.title: Guest's time to answer is over
rules.message: The guest can dispute a claim until the dispute window closes. Only after that does an unanswered claim stand.

rules.title: Claim within the deposit
rules.message: A claim can never exceed the security deposit.

rules.title: Pays exactly the claim
rules.check: def.toMerchant + def.toFee == def.booked + def.claimTotal && def.toGuest == def.deposit - def.claimTotal && def.toFee == bps(def.toMerchant + def.toFee, params.serviceFeeBps)
rules.message: The hotel gets the room plus the claim (less the fee); the rest of the deposit goes back to the guest.
